symptom: All 9 rule bots failed to convert the exact caramel-workshop target seeds 63400-63402 into 300s victories, even though the wider neighbor scan over seeds 63380-63420 found 16 same-map victory episodes across random, greedy, kite, boss-hunter, zone-control, and route.
root_cause: The current caramel-workshop late conversion failure surface is narrower and harder than the existing rule bot policies can solve on the exact target seeds. However, nearby successful seeds provide materially better same-map terminal coverage than the older seed 62301-only victory target dataset.
fix: Use the filtered rule-bot neighbor victory samples as diagnostic terminal-branch training input, not as a policy gate. Keep the current per-map edge branch plus all-map late filter as the no-regression baseline, and combine the new victory samples with low-weight clean risk rows before any new caramel terminal branch probe.
validation: Ran all-bot 300s caramel-workshop matrix for seeds 63400-63402 and 63380-63420, exported six successful-neighbor bot trajectory packs in the 210-300s window, filtered 8630 victory samples from 16 episodes, and compared the three current failing traces against the new dataset with nearest-neighbor diagnostics.
